corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The reply cleanly separates a defeasible explanatory default from an exceptionless metaphysical principle and correctly allows background theoretical considerations to justify departures from an experiential pattern. Principal limitation: The discussion establishes the possibility of warranted exceptions more clearly than it identifies concrete independent evidence making foundational limits such an exception in the present comparison. Live burden: The con case must articulate when explanatory pressure is overridden, demonstrate that the proposed stopping point earns exceptional status, and avoid treating mere availability of a theory as sufficient defeat of the default. Locked score: The very strong band reflects precise conceptual diagnosis, excellent responsiveness to the central explanatory moves, and appropriately modest calibration, with a limited deduction because the supporting discussion remains indirect and does not itself vindicate any particular unexplained foundation.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The symmetry challenge identifies a potentially serious undercutting problem by showing how apparently parallel forms of support can generate rival causal principles with consequences unfavorable to traditional theism. Principal limitation: The force of the objection depends upon genuine evidential parity, yet the move does not fully establish that the rival material-causal principle and the limits principle share equally relevant cases, modal scope, or explanatory motivation. Live burden: The con case must defend the proposed parallel closely enough that differences in causal type, domain, or background evidence cannot supply an inexpensive symmetry breaker. Locked score: The very strong band reflects clear formulation, direct relevance, conditional calibration, and substantial pressure upon the pro method, while preserving the unresolved question whether the alternative principle is genuinely co-supported rather than merely analogically suggestive.
